questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the heavy-to-light dμ/dn swings and the two entropy plateaus? The twist angle reads 1.06° ± 0.02° (p. 3), 1.08° (Fig. 1b caption, p. 6) and 1.07° (Methods, p. 22); are these one device?
Why were the other devices or cooldowns set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: other bias voltages for the dμ/dn extraction besides ±42 mV, the hole side for the temperature series and entropy, and fields above 6 T for the dμ/dn map?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like for Fig. 3a and Fig. 4c?

How was the exponent 0.258 in T(n) obtained, what is its uncertainty, and how do the negative dμ/dn dips in Fig. 2a and the masses in Fig. 3a change when it is varied over that range? Could you show the raw dI/dVg next to Extended Fig. 1b?

Eq. 3 is an approximation of Methods Eq. 7. How large is ρ(EF) compared with ρ(EF + eVb) at Vb = ±42 mV across the flat bands (Eq. 6 gives it from your data), how does the ~20 meV phonon offset enter the probed energy, and does dμ/dn keep its shape at other bias voltages?

For the entropy, the chemical potential at the CNP is set to 0 at every temperature (Extended Fig. 4a). How do Fig. 4c and Extended Fig. 4c change if μ at the CNP is allowed to drift with temperature, and if the fit uses more than three adjacent temperature points?

Do high-resolution dI/dVb(Vb, Vg) maps at 0.3 K show Coulomb-diamond-like features of the kind your group reported in a planar MATBG junction (arXiv 2106.11333), and what doping offset does the graphite probe induce in the region beneath it?
